description: Maintains an append-only per-component revision history as a JSONL trail (`<component>.trail.jsonl`) inside the Obsidian vault, next to the .tox and its provenance sidecar. Three actions: append a new revision entry (with optional sha256 of the .tox, changed-param list, author, and timestamp); read all entries back as JSON; export the trail as a human-readable markdown changelog note rendered into the vault. Offline — no TD bridge required. Pairs with save_component_to_vault and provenance_stamp.

action.description: append: add a new revision entry. read: return all entries as JSON. export: render the trail as a markdown changelog note next to the .tox.

componentPath.description: Vault-relative path to the .tox file (e.g. 'Components/MyFx.tox'). The trail is stored as a sibling file '<componentPath>.trail.jsonl'.

entry.description: Required when action='append'. Ignored for read/export.

author.description: Author label. Defaults to TDMCP_AUTHOR env var, then os.userInfo().username, then 'unknown'.

changedParams.description: Optional list of parameter paths whose values changed in this revision (e.g. ['transform1/tx','transform1/ty']).

note.description: Short human-readable description of this revision.

exportNoteName.description: On export, the markdown filename (defaults to '<component>.CHANGELOG.md' next to the .tox).

includeSha.description: On append, hash the .tox bytes with sha256 and store it on the entry — lets you cross-reference with provenance_stamp's sidecar.

name: component_changelog_trail
title: Component Changelog Trail
